map.二维码版本容量 使用指南: QR Code Version Capacity - User Guide
map.输入要编码的字符数量与编码模式（数字、字母或字节），工具估算所需的最低 QR 码: Enter the character count to encode and mode (numeric, alphanumeric or byte); the tool estimates the minimum QR version and capacity level, for generating a properly sized QR code.
map.QR 码版本 1-40，容量随版本和纠错等级变化: QR code version 1-40, capacity varies with version and error-correction level
map.二维码设计：按内容量选最小版本以减小图形密度、提升识读率。: QR design: choose the smallest version by content size to reduce module density and improve scannability.
map.容错权衡：在版本固定的情况下选择 L/M/Q/H 容错等级。: Fault-tolerance trade-off: choose L/M/Q/H error-correction level when version is fixed.
map.容量预警：预估超出 40 版上限时提示需分拆或缩短内容。: Capacity warning: when estimated to exceed version 40 limit, prompt to split or shorten content.
map.：数字模式约可容纳至版本 3（约 80+ 字符），版本 4 更稳妥，视容错等级而: : Numeric mode holds up to about version 3 (~80+ chars); version 4 is safer, depending on error-correction level.
map.QR 版本 1–40 决定模块数，版本越高容量越大，同版本下数字>字母>字节模式: QR version 1-40 determines module count; higher version means larger capacity; within a version, numeric > alphanumeric > byte mode capacity decreases.
map.影响。L(7%)容量最大、H(30%)最小，高容错牺牲容量换抗损。: Effect: L (7%) largest capacity, H (30%) smallest; higher fault tolerance trades capacity for damage resistance.
map.模块越少图形越稀疏、打印/屏幕识读越稳，过大反而易扫不出。: Fewer modules make the pattern sparser and print/screen scanning more stable; too large instead fails to scan.
